summary: Backend-only testing for Emergent Google Auth + multi-user data isolation. Created pytest suite that seeds two users + sessions directly in MongoDB and exercises auth endpoints, protected-endpoint guards, per-user regression flows, and cross-user isolation. All 23/23 tests passed.

minor.issue: Endpoint is NOT protected by get_current_user (no Depends), while every other data endpoint requires auth. Inconsistent with the multi-tenant requirement even though exercises are global.

Invalid session_id returns 502 (from requests.get exception path) in some cases instead of 401. Emergent endpoint may respond with non-200 mapped to 401, but network/DNS/timeouts surface as 502. Consider normalizing to 401 for consistency.
Cookie set with SameSite=None but no explicit Secure/httponly settings verification; also does not upsert user_sessions (multiple logins keep stacking rows for same token).
Does not validate that requesting user is a member of the league; any authed user can read any league ranking. Low severity, but worth noting.

action_items: Decide if GET /api/exercises should require auth (currently public).
Consider normalizing auth_session network errors to 401 vs 502.
Consider deduplicating user_sessions on repeated login and cleaning expired rows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 543-line file mixing models, seeding, auth, and business routes. Split into modules (auth.py, leagues.py, workouts.py, seeding.py) once app grows further.
seed_global uses a v2 flag; if any change is made to seed data (e.g., add new league), you'll need to bump to v3 or the update won't roll out.
get_current_user reads session_token from cookie OR Authorization header — good. But it reads user via db.users on every request; acceptable for small scale.
POST /api/measurements only accepts a fixed set of labels via mapping dict; measurements not in mapping are silently ignored (no 400 for unknown fields).
workout/complete increments league_members for ALL leagues the user is in — correct multi-league behavior, but no idempotency (a user can spam-complete).
test_credentials: Not required. Test users seeded directly into MongoDB (users + user_sessions collections) with Bearer tokens.
seed_data_creation: Two test users (test_user_A_*, test_user_B_*) inserted into users, user_sessions, fitness_profiles, dashboard_stats, today_workout, measurements, league_members(lg1). Cleaned up after module completes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth via Bearer token works end-to-end. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_auth_and_isolation.py can be re-run as regression. It self-cleans on module teardown. Note that /api/exercises is currently a public endpoint by design/omission — test accepts either 200 or 401.
